verdict.rationale: Temporal explicitly documents durable, long-running background automations — Schedules for triggering workflows at set times, automatic retries, crash-proof resume-from-failure execution, and dedicated AI docs on 'long-running, stateful agent loops that call LLMs and tools, wait on humans, and pick up exactly where they left off after a failure,' plus an OpenAI Agents SDK integration and a Claude agentic-loop cookbook. Community evidence corroborates real-world use for autonomous background processing (alert handling, provisioning, Reverse ETL) though one user reports error/anomaly handling for stuck workflows can be hard to debug. Missing for 10: no evidence of a no-code/turnkey setup (all examples require writing Workflow/Activity code and running Workers) and no independent benchmark of long-term autonomous reliability beyond anecdotal community reports.
